title: Crispy Tuna Furikake Roll
description: Creamy tuna and cucumber rolls finished with toasted panko and furikake.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Toast panko in sesame oil over low to medium heat until golden, then cool completely.
Drain tuna thoroughly, fold with Kewpie and set aside.
Spread rice onto nori, add cucumber and tuna mayo, roll firmly and cut into eight pieces.
Sprinkle toasted panko and furikake over the sliced pieces just before serving.
notes: Add crunchy toppings immediately before serving so they remain crisp.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
